    XDimension2D
    NodeShape.computeSize(XDimension2D label, DotAttributes attributes, boolean squareByName)
    The size of the inner outline of the node, following Graphviz poly_init: the label is padded by its margin, the shapes other than boxes grow so that the label fits inside them, then the result is at least width x height (0.75 x 0.5 inch by default), or exactly that with fixedsize=true.
